security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, validation wording, or dict.keys() usage. The confirmed risks are limited to documented Python command execution and in-place file rewriting of user-supplied quiz paths. No prompt injection, credential access, network access, or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Redistribution scripts rewrite the supplied quiz file in place.
remediation.suggestion: Create a backup or write to a new output file before replacing the original quiz markdown.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs users or agents to run a bundled Python script.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the script and show the exact target path before writing.

remediation.issue: The v2 script mentions an API key and imports subprocess, but the current implementation does not use them.
remediation.suggestion: Remove unused API-key wording and the unused subprocess import to reduce audit noise and user confusion.

content.value_statement: Writing fair chapter quizzes takes time and requires balanced answers, useful distractors, and clear feedback. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a repeatable Quiz component workflow.
actual_capabilities: Generates 50-question Quiz component drafts with four options per question.
Guides even correctOption distribution across indices 0 through 3.
Requires source fields that map each question to a lesson.
Prompts detailed immediate-feedback explanations for every answer.
Provides validation checklists for JSX, YAML, option count, and file naming.
Includes Python scripts that redistribute answer positions in markdown quiz files.
limitations: It depends on the host site having a globally registered Quiz component.
It does not verify subject accuracy without the source lessons.
The redistribution scripts rewrite the target file in place.
Rendered behavior still needs testing in the documentation site.

use_cases.title: Build Chapter Assessments
use_cases.description: Create a 50-question quiz that covers every lesson and supports randomized practice batches.

use_cases.title: Standardize Quiz Quality
use_cases.description: Apply consistent rules for answer balance, option length, source attribution, and explanation depth.

use_cases.title: Prepare Docusaurus Quiz Pages
use_cases.description: Format quiz content for a globally registered Quiz component with valid frontmatter and naming.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Quiz
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new chapter quiz.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 50-question Quiz component assessment for this chapter. Use four options, balanced answers, source fields, and immediate feedback explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Question Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing quiz draft for teaching value.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this quiz draft for recall questions, weak distractors, short explanations, and missing source fields. Return concrete revisions for each issue.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Answer Distribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the correctOption sequence for this quiz. Verify index balance, consecutive runs, answer patterns, and option-length bias.

prompt_templates.title: Finalize a Publishable Quiz
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the final chapter quiz file, apply the naming rules, validate JSX and YAML syntax, verify all 50 questions, and summarize remaining human checks.

output_examples.input: A four-lesson chapter on Python data types.
output_examples.output: A complete chapter quiz draft with 50 conceptual questions, balanced answer positions, lesson sources, and immediate feedback explanations.

output_examples.input: An existing quiz where most correct answers are the third option.
output_examples.output: A redistribution plan that balances correct answers across all four positions and flags explanations that need manual review.

output_examples.input: A draft quiz page for a documentation site.
output_examples.output: A validation report covering filename, frontmatter, component syntax, question count, option counts, sources, and explanation quality.

best_practices: Start from the chapter lessons and map every major concept before writing questions.
Manually verify option lengths, answer distribution, sources, and explanations before publishing.
Test the final page in the documentation site to confirm the Quiz component renders correctly.
anti_patterns: Do not create short quizzes when the component expects a 50-question bank.
Do not let the longest option become the correct answer most of the time.
Do not publish without checking that explanations match redistributed answer positions.

faq.question: What kind of quiz does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates 50-question interactive chapter quizzes for a Quiz component with randomized practice batches.

faq.question: Can it create static markdown quizzes?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written for the interactive Quiz component, not plain static question lists.

faq.question: Why does it require 50 questions?
faq.answer: The larger bank supports shuffled 15 to 20 question sessions and better retake variety.

faq.question: Does it balance correct answers automatically?
faq.answer: It provides scripts and checks for balancing, but the final quiz still needs review.

faq.question: Does it verify technical accuracy?
faq.answer: It guides review against chapter content, but a subject expert should approve the final questions.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
